Returns 401 for unknown user, wrong password, or disabled account — the
same error for all three to avoid leaking user existence (AUTH-003).
Returns 429 if the account or IP is temporarily locked (AUTH-004).

recovery code. On success, creates a session and sets the session cookie.

Returns 400 for invalid input (empty username, password too short).

successful snapshot remains active (constraint #19).

keep_on_fail.description: Whether to keep existing nodes if a refresh fails.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response for auth endpoints.

HealthStatusDto.description: Overall health status reported by health probes.

ImportNodesRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/v1/nodes/import` (NODE-001/002).

The `content` is a raw subscription payload (URI list, Base64, YAML, or
JSON). The server parses it with the same protocol parsers used for
source refresh and imports the resulting nodes into the pool with
dedup. `source_type` controls format detection; `auto` lets the server
detect from the content.

content.description: Raw subscription content to parse and import.

source_type.description: Input format. `auto` lets the server detect.

duplicate_nodes.description: Nodes already present (duplicate of an existing active node).

failed.description: Input lines that could not be parsed.

new_nodes.description: Nodes newly inserted into the pool.

outcomes.description: Per-line outcomes for diagnostics. Length equals the input line count.

oneOf.description: A new node was inserted; `data` is the node ULID.

data.description: A new node was inserted; `data` is the node ULID.

oneOf.description: The node was a duplicate; `data` is the existing node ULID.

data.description: The node was a duplicate; `data` is the existing node ULID.

oneOf.description: The line could not be parsed; `data` is the raw input text.

data.description: The line could not be parsed; `data` is the raw input text.

ImportOutcomeDto.description: Per-line outcome of a manual import.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page (`None` if no more results).
Cursor for the next page (`None` if no more results).

LoginResponse.description:
Response body for `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.

When `requires_2fa` is `true`, the client must complete the 2FA flow
using the `challenge_token` via `POST /api/v1/auth/login/2fa`. The
session cookie is NOT set in this case.

challenge_token.description:
Challenge token for the 2FA login endpoint. Present only when
`requires_2fa` is `true`.

requires_2fa.description: Whether 2FA verification is required to complete login.

challenge_token.description: Challenge token from the login response.

code.description: 6-digit TOTP code or a recovery code.

NodeDto.description:
A node in the unified pool, as returned by list/get endpoints.

Pool metadata (`missing_from_source`, `is_active`, `revision`) is
included alongside the canonical node fields. Sensitive fields
(raw URI with embedded credentials) are never serialized.

host.description: Endpoint host (IPv6 bracketed in URI form).

is_active.description: Whether the node is active (eligible for generation).

missing_from_source.description: Whether the node was marked missing after its source removed it.

region_method.description: How the region was assigned (auto-detected or manual override).

source_label.description: Source label (the source name, or `"manual"` for pasted nodes).

NodeOverrideDto.description: Manual override applied to a node, as seen in API responses.

display_name.description: Override display name; `None` keeps the parsed name.

enabled.description: Override enabled flag; `None` keeps natural status.

region.description: Override region; `None` keeps the auto-detected region.

NodeTagAssignmentDto.description: One node's tag assignment in a batch tags request.

ReconcileCountsDto.description: Reconciliation counts returned by a source refresh.

duplicate_nodes.description: Nodes already in the pool (duplicate of an existing active node).

missing_nodes.description: Nodes previously bound to this source that are no longer present.

new_nodes.description: Nodes newly inserted into the pool.

reactivated_nodes.description: Nodes that were missing and have been reactivated.

node_count.description: Number of nodes in the snapshot.

not_modified.description: Whether the server returned 304 Not Modified.

snapshot_id.description: ULID of the snapshot created (or the previously active one on 304).

RegenerateRecoveryCodesRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/v1/auth/2fa/recovery-codes`.

Requires the current password to prevent unauthorized regeneration.

recovery_codes.description: New single-use recovery codes (old codes are invalidated).

RegionMethodDto.description: How a node's region was assigned.

tag_ids.description: Tag IDs to assign to this node (replaces existing assignments).

region.description: `Some("US")` sets a manual region; `None` clears it.

SourceDto.description:
Source information returned by source management endpoints.

Never includes encrypted headers ciphertext in responses.

keep_on_fail.description: Whether to keep existing nodes if a refresh fails.

SourceTypeDto.description: Input format of a subscription source.

TwoFactorDisableRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/v1/auth/2fa/disable`.

Requires the current password to prevent unauthorized disabling from a
hijacked session.

TwoFactorSetupResponse.description:
Response body for `POST /api/v1/auth/2fa/setup`.

Returns the TOTP secret (Base32) for manual entry and an `otpauth://` URI
for QR code generation. The secret is not yet active until verified.

code.description: 6-digit TOTP code from the user's authenticator app.

TwoFactorVerifyResponse.description:
Response body for `POST /api/v1/auth/2fa/verify`.

Recovery codes are shown once. The user must store them securely.

display_name.description: Override display name; `None` clears the override.

keep_on_fail.description: Whether to keep existing nodes if a refresh fails.

UserDto.description:
User information returned by auth and user management endpoints.

Never includes `password_hash` or other secrets.

enabled.description: Whether the user can log in.

expires_at.description: Optional account expiry (ISO 8601 UTC). `None` means no expiry.

last_login_at.description: Last successful login time (ISO 8601 UTC). `None` if never logged in.
